verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's Composer AI feature explicitly translates a plain-language goal into an audience ('it'll build the audience') and the official MCP server lets an external agent (Claude/Cursor) interact with Klaviyo data for tasks like campaign creation, showing a programmatic AI-agent surface exists. However, there's no explicit documentation of a segment-creation endpoint or MCP tool specifically invoked from natural language, so the link between plain-language input and a real segment object via the API/MCP surface is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit MCP or API segment-creation tool documentation, and independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent can create a segment end-to-end.
